The offensive line acts as a force kernel, applying resistance to the defender’s net force, while the defensive line dynamically repositions to intercept. The system exhibits non-linear dynamics due to the discrete nature of snap events and the continuous evolution of player positions. Failure modes occur when the net force imbalance exceeds the blocking capacity or when defensive positioning breaks down under attack vector alignment.
